content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University is recruiting for a total of 3 positions. This includes 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant post and 2 vacancies for the Field Investigator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these MGU posts?
faq.answer: For the Research Assistant position, candidates need a Post Graduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities with at least 55% marks and NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. For the Field Investigator role, a Post Graduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities with a minimum of 55% marks is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator roles?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 37,000/-. The Research Assistant will be paid Rs. 37,000/- per month, and the Field Investigator will receive Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for these positions must be submitted via email. Candidates are advised to carefully prepare their application and send it to the designated email address as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these MGU jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official MGU Recruitment 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for MGU Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job postings?
faq.answer: The job postings are located in Kottayam, Kerala, with the university's pincode being 686041.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age limit relaxations mentioned?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or relaxations for these posts. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such details.
